main_text.p: nauidelicet panis externa, altera corporis Christi interna, perperam in unicam, & eandem conflata.vitare studeant, restituto poculi usu, & corporali panis esu, videant tandem, rogo & obtestor, an non unicam & eandem statuentes significationum & rerum significatarum mandationem, ex Scylla in Charibdin incidat. Nam, ut alia praeteream, de quibus alibi dicemus, quum in his mysteriis constare debeat Corpus & sanguinem Domini, non simpliciter & per se, quatenus, & ipsæ sunt substantiæ corporeæ, & sensibus ipsis perceptibiles, sed ut res, sicut recte loquitur Irenæus, cælestes, ac proinde fideli demum mente magis ac magis intelligendas, credendas, & ad spiritualis vitæ incrementum spirituali modo in nobis obsignandas proponi: quis sapientissimis etiam Theologis, persuaderi potuisse facile credat, ut repugnante ipsa rerum istarum natura, & ipso Sacramentorum usu sic euerso, una & eadem naturali in os præbitione externa, res illas sumendas præberi, & proinde una & eadem naturali, orali manducatione, & sensibili oris esu & potu sumi existimarent, ac proinde duas tam diversas personas, (Pastorem videlicet id quod exterius agitur, agentem, & Christum suo Spiritu sancto id quod intus fit, efficientem) velut in unam personam conflarent? duas tam diversas præbitiones, unam videlicet externam & sensibilem signorum sensibilium, alteram internam, & supernaturaliter intellectualem rerum significatarum, non aliter quam fidei oculo perceptibilium, in unam & quidem oralem, naturalem & sensibilem

page.notes: Running head and page number as printed. The first word of the marginal note reads "nauidelicet" in the scan and is copied as printed, with the u as a vowel. The catchword at the lower right is only partly legible and is given as "len[?]". The text runs on from the previous page, so the first paragraph is marked cont="true". Some words in the upper lines of the text are set in worn type and were read with care; "sensibilium" and "significatarum" are read from the scan. The line "statuentes significationum" is an uncertain reading of the print and should be checked against the original.
